_meta.source: Figma file uI6oKmJ0qDhsEuE0nFah2W, catalog page "Form / Blocks" (node 1307:2208).
_meta.purpose: Complete form modules. Each pattern carries its own selection metadata (intent / whenToUse / cardinality / alternatives) — there is no separate sections file.
_meta.levels: level "section" brings its own Section wrapper and is placed by a template slot. level "module" is embeddable inside another pattern and is reached via $ref.

form.intro.purpose: Form entry: h2 title, optional description and the required-field convention.
form.intro.intent: Name the form and state its conventions once.
form.intro.whenToUse: Always, exactly once, as the first section after the Header. The h1-level title of the page lives here.

form.text-fieldset.purpose: Fieldset of text fields, including one paired row.
form.text-fieldset.intent: Collect a group of related text values.
form.text-fieldset.whenToUse: The content is names, addresses, numbers or references. Pair two fields in a row only when they belong together.

form.choice-fieldset.purpose: Fieldset of choice controls: a radio group and a checkbox group.
form.choice-fieldset.intent: Collect choices from a fixed set of options.
form.choice-fieldset.whenToUse: The content is a decision among few visible options. Radio for exactly one, checkboxes for several, a Select instead when the list is long.

form.freetext-fieldset.purpose: Fieldset for free-form input with an optional consent checkbox.
form.freetext-fieldset.intent: Collect a longer message and an accompanying confirmation.
form.freetext-fieldset.whenToUse: The content is a comment, a message or a description that does not fit one line.

form.fields.purpose: Titled section holding one or more fieldsets.
form.fields.intent: Group the form's questions into one titled step.
form.fields.whenToUse: One section per thematic group of questions. Split into several sections rather than stacking twenty unlabelled fields.

form.choices.intent: Group the form's decisions into one titled step.
form.choices.whenToUse: The group is about selecting options rather than entering values.

form.message.purpose: Titled section for a free-form message plus consent.
form.message.intent: Let the user write a longer message and confirm something.
form.message.whenToUse: Contact and feedback forms, or any step whose main input is prose.

form.submit.purpose: Closing section with the submit action row.
form.submit.intent: Let the user submit, or step back.
form.submit.whenToUse: Always, exactly once, as the final section. The Brand button here is the page's single primary action.
